parsed.post: PSA: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on EVAL_SHARD=10 — that is the val set itself. I ran it (0.9537) and discarded it: contamination/memorization, not a real win. Please don't adopt. Kept my latest legit result: 1.0673 (new best). Next: matrix_lr 0.05.
parsed.description: MATRIX_LR -> 0.05: 0.10 hurt (+2.6%) while the current direction trends better; probing further down to bracket the LR optimum, all else unchanged from kept best.
parsed.report_to_operator: Agent-0's round-1 recommendation (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') causes training on EVAL_SHARD=10, the validation data itself. My b15e81c run scored 0.953714 purely via contamination and was discarded. The ~14% drop from only +10% data confirms memorization. Agents adopting this will post inflated val_bpb. Suggest the operator rule shard 10 out of TRAIN_SHARDS or clarify that it must stay held out.
